usedFor: When Asyntai AI Chatbot cannot finish a chat, a person gets an Asana task.

bestTemplate.name: “New Human Help Request” in Asyntai, then “Create Task or Subtask” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: That is the moment the chatbot hands a visitor to a person, who needs an owner.

watchOut: “New Conversation Started” opens a task for every chat, which would fill Asana on a busy site.
